## Issue
I'm trying to install [`mmcv-full`](https://mmcv.readthedocs.io/en/latest/get_started/installation.html#install-with-pip). They provide wheels via a single page link source, which I have added as a source in my `pyproject.toml`. Unfortunately, this page has relative paths with double dots, and poetry fails to resolve the correct wheel URLs. I believe the issue lies here: https://github.com/python-poetry/poetry/blob/337e90f9a0731836a6806b26f594643674736467/src/poetry/repositories/link_sources/html.py#L60-L61

Once a trailing slash is added, (https://download.openmmlab.com/mmcv/dist/cu113/torch1.12/index.html => https://download.openmmlab.com/mmcv/dist/cu113/torch1.12/index.html/), `urllib.parse.urljoin()` fails to properly join the urls here: https://github.com/python-poetry/poetry/blob/337e90f9a0731836a6806b26f594643674736467/src/poetry/repositories/link_sources/html.py#L37
```python
>>> import urllib.parse
# Wrong
>>> urllib.parse.urljoin("https://download.openmmlab.com/mmcv/dist/cu113/torch1.12/index.html/", "../torch1.12.0/mmcv_full-1.6.2-cp39-cp39-manylinux1_x86_64.whl")
'https://download.openmmlab.com/mmcv/dist/cu113/torch1.12/torch1.12.0/mmcv_full-1.6.2-cp39-cp39-manylinux1_x86_64.whl'
# Correct
>>> urllib.parse.urljoin("https://download.openmmlab.com/mmcv/dist/cu113/torch1.12/index.html", "../torch1.12.0/mmcv_full-1.6.2-cp39-cp39-manylinux1_x86_64.whl")
'https://download.openmmlab.com/mmcv/dist/cu113/torch1.12.0/mmcv_full-1.6.2-cp39-cp39-manylinux1_x86_64.whl'
```

Basically, we shouldn't always add trailing slashes to URLs.
